# ffxf_api_key (Resource)

Creates an API key that acts through a role. The API has no update endpoint, so every change replaces the key. The secret is only returned at creation and is kept in the Terraform state; protect your state accordingly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_api_key" "ci" {
  name       = "ci"
  role       = "readers"
  expires_at = "2030-12-31"
}

output "ci_api_key" {
  value     = ffxf_api_key.ci.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key name, up to 64 characters.

### Optional

- `assumable_roles` (List of String) Ids or names of the roles obtainable through token exchange. Required when exchange_only is true.
- `exchange_only` (Boolean) When true the key can only be exchanged for a short-lived token through POST /auth/token and is refused everywhere else.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format; it must be in the future.
- `ip_addresses` (List of String) Restrict the key to these IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, at most 50.
- `role` (String) Id or name of the role the key has the rights of. Required unless exchange_only is true.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the key is enabled.
- `id` (Number) API key identifier.
- `last_used_at` (String) Timestamp of the last request made with the key.
- `prefix` (String) Non-secret key prefix shown in the console.
- `role_id` (Number) Identifier of the role the key holds, null for exchange-only keys.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The secret key, only available from creation. It is empty after an import.
